DISCOVERY 612, PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST'S APPLICATION FOR WRIT OF POSSESSION IS GRANTED. NO OPPOSITION HAS BEEN FILED. THE UNDERTAKING FOR PLAINTIFF IS WAIVED. THE UNDERTAKING FOR DEFENDANT TO PREVENT PLAINTIFF FROM TAKING POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY IS SET IN THE AMOUNT OF $7,000. ORDER WAS SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER EVERETT A. HEWLETT, JR. CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PARK, HYUNG MAN INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA STILSON BROTHERS CLEANERS POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: ONE EPSON INVOICE PRINTER, ETC. -SEE JUDGMENT AT LENGTH., OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT , PROPERTY FAIR MARKET VALUE OF THE EQUIPMENT IS $7,000.
